senses.def: a large, expensive boat used for pleasure or racing
senses.ex: They spent the summer sailing around the islands on a yacht.
senses.exPt: Eles passaram o verão navegando pelas ilhas em um iate.

senses.def: the area of land next to a house
senses.ex: The kids are playing in the yard.
senses.exPt: As crianças estão brincando no quintal.

senses.def: to open your mouth wide and breathe in because you are tired or bored
senses.ex: He kept yawning during the meeting.
senses.exPt: Ele não parava de bocejar durante a reunião.

senses.def: the act of opening your mouth wide because you are tired or bored
senses.ex: She tried to hide a yawn behind her hand.
senses.exPt: Ela tentou esconder um bocejo com a mão.

senses.def: an informal way of saying yes
senses.ex: Oh yeah, I remember him now.
senses.exPt: Ah, sim, agora me lembro dele.

senses.def: a period of twelve months
senses.ex: I moved to this city two years ago.
senses.exPt: Eu me mudei para esta cidade há dois anos.

senses.def: to want something very much, especially something hard to get
senses.ex: She yearned for a quiet life in the countryside.
senses.exPt: Ela ansiava por uma vida tranquila no campo.

senses.def: to shout very loudly
senses.ex: Please stop yelling at me, I can hear you.
senses.exPt: Por favor, para de gritar comigo, eu estou te ouvindo.

senses.def: a loud shout
senses.ex: She gave a yell when she saw the spider.
senses.exPt: Ela deu um grito quando viu a aranha.

senses.def: having the color of a lemon or the sun
senses.ex: She bought a yellow dress for the party.
senses.exPt: Ela comprou um vestido amarelo para a festa.

senses.def: used to agree or to give a positive answer
senses.ex: Yes, I'd love a cup of tea.
senses.exPt: Sim, eu adoraria uma xícara de chá.

senses.def: on the day before today
senses.ex: I saw your brother at the supermarket yesterday.
senses.exPt: Vi seu irmão no supermercado ontem.

senses.def: used in negatives: until now
senses.ex: I haven't finished my homework yet.
senses.exPt: Ainda não terminei a lição de casa.

senses.def: used in questions: before now
senses.ex: Have you had lunch yet?
senses.exPt: Você já almoçou?

senses.def: to produce a result, profit or crop
senses.ex: The investment yielded a ten percent return.
senses.exPt: O investimento rendeu dez por cento de retorno.

senses.def: to finally agree to do what someone wants after pressure
senses.ex: The government finally yielded to public pressure.
senses.exPt: O governo finalmente cedeu à pressão popular.

senses.def: a type of exercise with stretching and breathing to relax
senses.ex: My mother does yoga three times a week.
senses.exPt: Minha mãe faz ioga três vezes por semana.

senses.def: a thick food made from milk, often with fruit
senses.ex: I have yogurt and fruit for breakfast.
senses.exPt: Eu como iogurte com fruta no café da manhã.

senses.def: the person or people you are talking to
senses.ex: Are you hungry?
senses.exPt: Você está com fome?

senses.def: the person you are talking to, as the object of a verb
senses.ex: I'll call you tomorrow morning.
senses.exPt: Eu te ligo amanhã de manhã.

senses.def: having lived for only a short time
senses.ex: My grandmother was very beautiful when she was young.
senses.exPt: Minha avó era muito bonita quando era jovem.

senses.def: belonging to the person you are talking to
senses.ex: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
senses.exPt: Posso pegar sua caneta emprestada um minuto?

senses.def: used to show that something belongs to the person you are talking to
senses.ex: Is this phone yours or mine?
senses.exPt: Esse celular é seu ou meu?

senses.def: used to say that you did something without help
senses.ex: Did you make this cake yourself?
senses.exPt: Foi você mesmo que fez esse bolo?

senses.def: used when the person you are talking to does and receives the action
senses.ex: Be careful not to hurt yourself with that knife.
senses.exPt: Cuidado para não se machucar com essa faca.

senses.def: the time of life when you are young
senses.ex: He spent his youth in a small village.
senses.exPt: Ele passou a juventude em uma cidadezinha.

senses.def: young people in general, or for young people
senses.ex: There's a new youth centre in our town.
senses.exPt: Tem um novo centro para jovens na nossa cidade.

senses.def: young, or looking or seeming young
senses.ex: She has a very youthful appearance for her age.
senses.exPt: Ela tem uma aparência muito jovem para a idade.

senses.def: tasting very good (informal)
senses.ex: This chocolate cake is so yummy!
senses.exPt: Esse bolo de chocolate é muito gostoso!
